fontes.raw: AUG, l. XX, contr. Faust., c. 21

heads.la: PROLOGUS [cn: a | Deerat iste prologus in eo, quem publici juris facimus, codice manuscripto, propterea quod exciderat prae vetustate primum ejus folium. Eum vero nobis suppeditavit V. C. Pithaei exemplar ejusdem fere, tum characteris, tum aetatis, teste D. Jacobo du Breul, hujusce coenobii monacho, qui Prologi istius fronti observationem hanc praefixit. Notandum praeterea non reperiri in Solleriata Usuardi editione. BOUILLART.] AD CAROLUM CALVUM.
heads.en: PROLOGUE [nt: This prologue was lacking in the manuscript codex which we are making public, because its first leaf had fallen out through age. It was supplied to us, however, by the copy of the most distinguished man (V. C.) Pithou, of almost the same character both of script and of age, on the witness of Dom Jacques du Breul, a monk of this monastery, who prefixed this observation to the front of that Prologue. It is to be noted besides that it is not found in Sollerius's edition of Usuardus. Bouillart.] TO CHARLES THE BALD.

heads.la: PROLOGUS [cn: a | Desideratur secundus iste prologus in ea quam Sollerius adornavit Usuardi editione; at reperitur in Usuardi ejusdem codicibus fere omnibus manu exaratis, qui in bibliotheca Pratensi asservantur et in multis aliis. BOUILLART.] ALTER EX LIBRIS BEATI AUGUSTI. Qualiter colendi sint sancti.
heads.en: ANOTHER PROLOGUE [nt: This second prologue is missing in the edition of Usuardus which Sollerius prepared; but it is found in almost all the handwritten codices of the same Usuardus which are kept in the library of the Prés, and in many others. Bouillart.], FROM THE BOOKS OF BLESSED AUGUSTUS [cj: AUGUSTI; read AUGUSTINI, "of Augustine"]. How the saints are to be honoured.
